description.value:
Trigger You drop below half your maximum Hit Points.

For the rest of the encounter, every Redline you spend counts as the first Redline of the encounter: it is clean and you roll no Slip. This persists even if you are healed back above half Hit Points — once the job is the last one, it stays the last one.

cinderfall.incomplete: Every Redline for the rest of the encounter is clean (no Slip), and this persists even if the caster is healed back above half HP. Deadhand's Redline/Slip mechanic is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus.
